UpdateStageName: Run PostgreSQL with fail-closed TLS selection
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Base=${HM_PG_BASE_DIR:?}; ListenAddress=${HM_PG_LISTEN_ADDRESS:?}; TLSHostname=${HM_PG_TLS_HOSTNAME:?}; [[ \"$Base\" == /*/ ]] || { echo 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"${PGPORT:?}\" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((PGPORT >= 1 && PGPORT <= 65535)) || { echo 'Invalid PostgreSQL port'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$ListenAddress\" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F:.,]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid listen address'; exit 1; }; cd \"$Base\"; if pgsql/bin/pg_isready --host=\"${Base}run\" --port=\"$PGPORT\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Refusing to treat an existing socket responder as this managed PostgreSQL instance'; exit 1; fi; Cert=\"${Base}tls/server.crt\"; Key=\"${Base}tls/server.key\"; TLSArgs=(--ssl=off); if [[ -s \"$Cert\" || -s \"$Key\" ]]; then [[ -s \"$Cert\" && -s \"$Key\" ]] || { echo 'Both server.crt and server.key are required'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$TLSHostname\" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$ && \"$TLSHostname\" != 'REPLACE_BEFORE_TLS_USE' ]] || { echo 'A valid exact TLS hostname is required'; exit 1; }; KeyMode=$(stat -c '%a' \"$Key\"); KeyOwner=$(stat -c '%u' \"$Key\"); [[ \"$KeyMode\" == '600' ]] || { echo 'server.key must have mode 0600'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$KeyOwner\" == \"$(id -u)\" ]] || { echo 'server.key must be owned by the PostgreSQL service identity'; exit 1; }; openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -checkhost \"$TLSHostname\"; openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -checkend 86400; NotBefore=$(openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -noout -startdate | cut -d= -f2-); [[ $(date -d \"$NotBefore\" +%s) -le $(date +%s) ]] || { echo 'Certificate is not yet valid'; exit 1; }; CertKeyHash=$(openssl x509 -in \"$Cert\" -pubkey -noout | openssl pkey -pubin -outform DER | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); PrivateKeyHash=$(openssl pkey -passin pass: -in \"$Key\" -pubout -outform DER | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); [[ \"$CertKeyHash\" == \"$PrivateKeyHash\" ]] || { echo 'Certificate and private key do not match'; exit 1; }; openssl verify -purpose sslserver -verify_hostname \"$TLSHostname\" -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt -untrusted \"$Cert\" \"$Cert\"; TLSArgs=(--ssl=on --ssl_cert_file=\"$Cert\" --ssl_key_file=\"$Key\" --ssl_min_protocol_version=TLSv1.2); echo 'Certificate identity, validity, chain, ownership and key match passed'; else echo 'TLS certificate absent: local administration only; HBA rejects every remote plaintext connection'; fi; pgsql/bin/postgres -D \"${Base}data\" -p \"$PGPORT\" -k \"${Base}run\" --external_pid_file=\"${Base}run/postgres.pid\" --listen_addresses=\"$ListenAddress\" \"${TLSArgs[@]}\" &"

UpdateStageName: Verify exact PostgreSQL instance and TLS state
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Base=${HM_PG_BASE_DIR:?}; ExpectedVersion=${HM_PG_VERSION:?}; timeout=60; while ((timeout--)); do \"${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_isready\" --host=\"${Base}run\" --port=\"${PGPORT:?}\" --username=amp --dbname=postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 && break || sleep 1; done; ((timeout>=0)) || { echo 'PostgreSQL failed to start'; exit 1; }; Info=$(\"${Base}pgsql/bin/psql\" --host=\"${Base}run\" --port=\"$PGPORT\" --username=amp --dbname=postgres --tuples-only --no-align --field-separator='|' --command=\"SELECT current_setting('server_version'), current_setting('data_directory'), current_setting('port'), current_setting('unix_socket_directories'), current_setting('ssl'), pg_backend_pid(), (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_hba_file_rules WHERE error IS NOT NULL)\"); IFS='|' read -r ServerVersion DataDirectory ServerPort SocketDirectories SSLState BackendPid HbaErrors <<< \"$Info\"; [[ \"$ServerVersion\" == \"$ExpectedVersion\" ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL server version'; exit 1; }; [[ $(realpath \"$DataDirectory\") == $(realpath \"${Base}data\") ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL data directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$ServerPort\" == \"$PGPORT\" ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL port'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$SocketDirectories\" == *\"${Base}run\"* ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL socket directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$HbaErrors\" == '0' ]] || { echo 'PostgreSQL rejected one or more HBA rules'; exit 1; }; ExpectedExecutable=$(readlink -f \"${Base}pgsql/bin/postgres\"); ActualExecutable=$(readlink -f \"/proc/${BackendPid}/exe\"); [[ \"$ActualExecutable\" == \"$ExpectedExecutable\" ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL executable'; exit 1; }; if [[ -s \"${Base}tls/server.crt\" ]]; then [[ \"$SSLState\" == 'on' ]] || { echo 'TLS certificate is present but PostgreSQL SSL is not on'; exit 1; }; else [[ \"$SSLState\" == 'off' ]] || { echo 'Unexpected PostgreSQL SSL state'; exit 1; }; fi; echo \"Exact PostgreSQL instance readiness passed; server_version=$ServerVersion ssl=$SSLState\""
